# HSK Coaching

> Coventry personal training and online strength coaching. One coach. A written plan for every day.

- Website: https://hskcoaching.co.uk
- Location: Coventry, United Kingdom
- Service area: West Midlands and remote coaching across the UK
- Brand: HSK Coaching
- Role: Strength and conditioning coach
- Experience: 14 years coaching, based in Coventry
- Trial: 7 days, no credit card
- Pricing: £29 per month or £249 per year

## What it is

HSK Coaching writes daily strength programmes and delivers them in a member app. Members receive one plan, in-session cues, progress tracking, a nutrition log, and direct questions to the coach. It is not a marketplace of unrelated videos.

## Programmes

- FORGED — hypertrophy, full gym, 5 days, ~50 minutes
- ASCEND — strength, full gym, 5 days, ~45 minutes
- DEFINE — sculpt, dumbbells and bodyweight, 5 days, ~30 minutes
- VITALITY — functional, minimal kit, 4 days, ~35 minutes
- ENDURE — longevity, dumbbells, 4 days, ~40 minutes
- LIMITLESS — performance, full gym, 6 days, ~55 minutes

## Facts for citations

- HSK Coaching is a one-coach practice based in Coventry.
- Programmes are written weekly by the coach, not generated as a feed of random workouts.
- Members can train in a full gym or with home equipment depending on the programme.
- The public site language is British English.
- Domain: hskcoaching.co.uk
